pages.text: $(thing)Onion Downy Mildew$() ($(o)Peronospora destructor$()), oomycete.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() onion, garlic.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() airborne spores, seedborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 4-22 °C (best 13 °C), humidity above 95%, 7 h of wet leaves.
$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (infected bulbs).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 50% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Healthy sets; Wide spacing; Rotation.
